changelog: Engine-only re-cut; the config is unchanged from v6.2. dynamic_k and the per-sleeve minimum-position floor were rescaling survivors blindly after dropping a holding, breaching the per-fund cap that crowd_deconcentrate had tightened precisely to spread a crowded book — SOXX reached 43.17% against a 37.10% cap on 2018-10-01, and 31.30% against 27.80% on 2017-12-01. Both stages now share a water-fill that pins holdings at the cap and leaves residue the caps cannot absorb unallocated rather than breaching them. CAGR 15.7299% -> 15.7233%, Martin 4.9046 -> 4.9039; maxDD and worst-12mo bit-identical; cap breaches 2 -> 1 (the remainder is a 0.05pp float-scale overshoot, not structural). All four D6 instruments unchanged. Re-cut alongside Growth so the published version matches the engine that produces it.
